title: angolluma baldratii
intro: Angolluma baldratii, commonly known as "Devil's Claw," is a succulent plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation associated with arthritis and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Angolluma baldratii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include harpagoside, which is a key compound responsible for its medicinal effects, along with other glycosides and alkaloids.
